messages:
deploy-bot: rolling out v3.8.0 -> prod(us-west,us-east). Postdeploy smoke suite kicked: prefill, kv-warmup, synth-chat. short watch 20m. :rocket:

amy.ops: FYI: first prefill sweep shows token drift on us-east-2b only, ~3/20 seeds diverged vs baseline. no 5xx, no latency spikes.

suresh_ml: can you attach a sample diff? wondering if it's tokenizer mapping or quant rounding.

amy.ops: sample diff inline:
```
baseline: "The model will"
new:      "The model will\n"
```
looks like spurious newline token insertion at step 2.

jordan_be: newline token could be a tokenizer merge bug after the new fast-bpe patch. That patch only landed in the runtime path for the new build.

oncall: what's the blast radius? single AZ or host?

amy.ops: only host edge-23 in us-east-2b returned bad seeds. other hosts in same AZ good.

infra-bot: probe-job started job-9021 target=edge-23 tests=[prefill,kv-warmup] by amy.ops

suresh_ml: suggest two actions: 1) pin routing for that host/az to previous model build (v3.7.x) 2) trigger a targeted warmup that exercises tokenizer hot path (`/infra warmup edge-23 --mode=tokenizer`) and rerun probes.

jordan_be: we can do a soft traffic split instead of hard pin: 95% -> v3.8.0, 5% -> v3.7.2 for the AZ. buys validation while limiting impact.

amy.ops: I'm leaning soft-split + targeted warmup. lower customer impact.

oncall: agree. apply split and warmup. watch for content-regression alert.

deploy-bot: routing change: traffic-split service:inference-us-east-2b -> {v3.8.0:95,v3.7.2:5} (rule id: split-2026-1765) :white_check_mark:

amy.ops: triggered warmup: `/infra warmup edge-23 --mode=tokenizer --retries=2`

infra-bot: warmup completed, retries=2. results: prefill match 17/20 seeds. 3 seeds still show newline insertion.

suresh_ml: reproducible on that host under warmup -> points to binary path or model artifact on host. Could be stale cached tokenizer file. Can we flush tokenizer cache on that host?

jordan_be: flushing cache and re-pulling artifacts now: `/ops ssh edge-23 -- sudo service artifact-sync && rm -rf /var/cache/tokenizer/* && systemctl restart inference`

amy.ops: artifact-sync completed, restart OK. rerunning probes.

infa-bot: probe-job started job-9027 target=edge-23 tests=[prefill] by infra-bot

amy.ops: new probe shows 20/20 matching. good.

oncall: excellent. reduce split back to 100% v3.8.0 for the AZ? or keep 95/5 for longer?

suresh_ml: keep 95/5 for the remainder of the watch window (15m) to ensure no flakiness reappears. Add an alert to auto-pin if content-regression rate > 1% over 5m.

amy.ops: set alert: prefills.content_regression_rate(us-east-2b) > 0.01 for 5m -> auto-action: pin to v3.7.2 and notify #incidents.

deploy-bot: postdeploy note: edge-23 tokenizer cache corruption detected, artifact sync + restart resolved. traffic-split set 95/5 for us-east-2b, watch 15m remaining. next update at 1765452000.

marie_prod: adding to release notes: "Targeted tokenizer cache issue observed in us-east-2b during postdeploy smoke; mitigated by artifact sync and warmup. Traffic temporarily reduced to 95% for validation. Investigating fast-bpe runtime patch."

oncall: no rollback needed. keeping change window open until watch expires.

amy.ops: ack. will close thread after watch expires. :white_check_mark:
